verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents its own Teams Export APIs for exporting 1:1, group, meeting and channel chat messages, including deleted messages for up to 21 days (ms-teams-docs-13, ms-teams-docs-14). This is a real first-party export capability, but it covers only messages, needs programmatic API use, and the evidence never states the output format. missing for 10: export of all data types (files, meetings, recordings, team configuration), documented open/portable output formats, a user-facing self-serve export, guidance on migrating away, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
